# Adnan Studios

> Adnan Studios is a product design and development studio. We design in Figma and ship in Next.js, Flutter, and WordPress. Zero Handoff means one studio owns the product from wireframe to production — no designer-to-developer gap.

## About

- Business: Adnan Studios
- Founder: Adnan Adil
- Specialization: Zero Handoff product design and development (Figma to Next.js, Flutter, or WordPress)
- Website: https://www.adnanstudios.com
- Contact: hello@adnanstudios.com

## Key Facts

- DeafTawk serves 68,000+ users with 3,200+ interpreters. Interpreter connection time dropped from ~60 minutes to under 30 seconds.
- QuizWiz receives 60,000+ monthly visits with a 4.7 star review rating.
- Starter package: $5,000 for up to 10 screens, 4-6 week delivery.
- Professional package: $15,000 for up to 30 screens, 6-8 week delivery.
- Enterprise package: custom pricing with unlimited screens and ongoing support.

## Services

Adnan Studios offers three packages: Starter ($5k), Professional ($15k), and Enterprise (custom). All packages include Figma design and production development by the same studio — Next.js, Flutter, or WordPress depending on the product. No separate developer handoff required.
